1.web: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.
1.asv: In the third month after the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.

2.web: When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain.
2.asv: And when they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mount.

3.web: Moses went up to God, and Yahweh called to him out of the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:
3.asv: And Moses went up unto God, and Jehovah called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:

4.web: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.
4.asv: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.

5.web: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice, and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine;
5.asv: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be mine own possession from among all peoples: for all the earth is mine:

6.web: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests, and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel.”
6.asv: and ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and a holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.

7.web: Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which Yahweh commanded him.
7.asv: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which Jehovah commanded him.

8.web: All the people answered together, and said, “All that Yahweh has spoken we will do.” Moses reported the words of the people to Yahweh.
8.asv: And all the people answered together, and said, All that Jehovah hath spoken we will do. And Moses reported the words of the people unto Jehovah.

9.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever.” Moses told the words of the people to Yahweh.
9.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and may also believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto Jehovah.

10.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,
10.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to-day and to-morrow, and let them wash their garments,

11.web: and be ready against the third day; for on the third day Yahweh will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount Sinai.
11.asv: and be ready against the third day; for the third day Jehovah will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.

12.web: You shall set bounds to the people all around, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t go up onto the mountain, or touch its border. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.
12.asv: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:

13.web: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether it is animal or man, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain.”
13.asv: no hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, he shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.

14.web: Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
14.asv: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their garments.

15.web: He said to the people, “Be ready by the third day. Don’t have sexual relations with a woman.”
15.asv: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not near a woman.

16.web: On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet; and all the people who were in the camp trembled.
16.asv: And it came to pass on the third day, when it was morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of a trumpet exceeding loud; and all the people that were in the camp trembled.

17.web: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.
17.asv: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.

18.web: Mount Sinai, all it, smoked, because Yahweh descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.
18.asv: And mount Sinai, the whole of it, smoked, because Jehovah descended upon it in fire; and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.

19.web: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.
19.asv: And when the voice of the trumpet waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.

20.web: Yahweh came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. Yahweh called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.
20.asv: And Jehovah came down upon mount Sinai, to the top of the mount: and Jehovah called Moses to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.

21.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to Yahweh to gaze, and many of them perish.
21.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto Jehovah to gaze, and many of them perish.

22.web: Let the priests also, who come near to Yahweh, sanctify themselves, lest Yahweh break out on them.”
22.asv: And let the priests also, that come near to Jehovah, sanctify themselves, lest Jehovah break forth upon them.

23.web: Moses said to Yahweh, “The people can’t come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.’”
23.asv: And Moses said unto Jehovah, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou didst charge us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.

24.web: Yahweh said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through to come up to Yahweh, lest he break out against them.”
24.asv: And Jehovah said unto him, Go, get thee down; and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto Jehovah, lest he break forth upon them.

25.web: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.
25.asv: So Moses went down unto the people, and told them.
